text: {"assertions":["On 2026-06-15, work was done on search/indexer/chunker.ts to fix an issue with truncated documents in the search indexing system.","The truncated documents problem primarily affected users with negative UTC offsets.","The root cause of the truncation was a cache entry that was never invalidated when data was written.","The fix involved invalidating the cache entry inside the write transaction, submitted as PR #3294 on branch fix/truncated-documents-1.","The truncated documents issue can be reproduced by indexing the long changelog fixture.","The search/indexer/chunker.ts code is covered by tests in search/indexer/chunker.test.ts.","The fix reduced the error rate from 3.4% to under 0.05% (5 per ten thousand)."]}
